image_requests.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: presentation photo/illustration layer; 16:9 composition.
Primary request: Original fictional adaptive desk lamp with flat graphite circular head, brass hinge and graphite stem/base on a warm ivory desktop.
Purpose: Establish the product silhouette and a quiet launch mood.
Style/medium: Professional editorial photography with believable materials and controlled lighting.
Composition/framing: Subject on the right 45%; quiet negative space across the left 50% for native slide text.
Color palette: background #F4F3EE, ink #202623, restrained accent #B0772A.
Constraints: no text, logos, watermark, chart labels or invented data; leave all slide typography native.
Identity: original fictional subject; do not imitate a named real product or venue.

limits: Host interprets meaning and supplies truthful data. Fixed recipes automate geometry, not aesthetic judgment.

pages.title: 弧光
pages.appearance: Full-bleed subject photograph with an unobstructed text area; large regular-weight display title, smaller sans subtitle, restrained rule and native disclosure.
pages.communication_reason: 产品名称与右侧摄影形成一个明确焦点，留白容纳原生标题。
pages.decoration: Functional rules, ordinal steps and material imagery; no unrelated badges or colored keyword spans.

pages.title: 随环境调光，保留手动选择
pages.appearance: A tall material photograph occupies the left side. The right side holds a compact display headline and measured feature rows with matched line icons, readable descriptions and subtle separators.
pages.communication_reason: 一张材质特写配合三段完整功能说明；图标标识具体功能，避免彩色卡片。
pages.decoration: Functional rules, ordinal steps and material imagery; no unrelated badges or colored keyword spans.

pages.title: 阅读是最多见的桌面任务
pages.appearance: A large sourced readout and its explanation anchor the left column; a native sorted bar chart occupies the right. One category may carry semantic emphasis. Keep zero baseline and direct values.
pages.communication_reason: 类别排名使用排序条形图；重点是阅读，其余类别保持中性。
pages.decoration: Functional rules, ordinal steps and material imagery; no unrelated badges or colored keyword spans.

pages.title: 一半使用时长发生在家庭书桌
pages.appearance: A narrow headline column names the finding and the whole; a native pie/ring occupies the middle; direct category/value labels form a right-hand ledger. Tonal colors separate parts, not unrelated decoration.
pages.communication_reason: 同一总时长的三个组成部分使用环形图与直接标注，分母紧邻图形。
pages.decoration: Functional rules, ordinal steps and material imagery; no unrelated badges or colored keyword spans.

pages.title: 试用人数的逐月累计
pages.appearance: A native time-series plot spans the lower field. A compact upper readout repeats the final observed value and its period; retain time order, units, axis and source qualifier.
pages.communication_reason: 按月份保留顺序，以连续折线显示同一指标，避免把时间点排成类别排名。
pages.decoration: Functional rules, ordinal steps and material imagery; no unrelated badges or colored keyword spans.

pages.title: 同一操作脚本中的动作次数
pages.appearance: Two matched conditions share a scale. Task labels sit left, endpoint values sit next to their marks, and a restrained legend identifies the conditions. Preserve the qualification near the title.
pages.communication_reason: 相同任务的两组值在共享刻度上以哑铃图对照；端点直接写明数值。
pages.decoration: Functional rules, ordinal steps and material imagery; no unrelated badges or colored keyword spans.

pages.title: 假设工况下的能耗核算
pages.appearance: A proportional editable waterfall links baseline, signed contributions and ending total. Native numeric labels and unit sit near the evidence; connectors explain continuity.
pages.communication_reason: 可正可负的变化从基准逐步连接至结余，瀑布图在比例和加总上保持一致。
pages.decoration: Functional rules, ordinal steps and material imagery; no unrelated badges or colored keyword spans.

pages.title: 一次调光的功能逻辑
pages.appearance: A continuous numbered rail establishes sequence. Each step has a quiet large ordinal, a small semantic icon, a concise label and its complete explanation; arrows communicate direction.
pages.communication_reason: 顺序关系用连续箭头和一致线性图标表达，文字与图形形成同一条阅读路径。
pages.decoration: Functional rules, ordinal steps and material imagery; no unrelated badges or colored keyword spans.

pages.title: 系统结构
pages.appearance: Measured native parent-child or cycle connections preserve the actual relation. Distinguish root and leaves through type and position; use symbols only where they identify meaning.
pages.communication_reason: 真实父子关系用分支连接表达；不把组成关系画成时间流程。
pages.decoration: Functional rules, ordinal steps and material imagery; no unrelated badges or colored keyword spans.
